name: tds-sections
description: TDS rates and thresholds a resident freelancer or small business commonly sees deducted from its receipts, Income-tax Act 2025 (in force from 1 April 2026), with the matching Income-tax Act 1961 section. Base rates only: whether surcharge or cess is added was not checked. The 2025 Act's section 393 does not name the 1961 sections; the old_section values pair rows by payment description on the two official TDS rate pages (tds_rates_2025 and tds_rates_1961). TDS is on the amount without GST when GST is shown separately on the invoice (circular_23_2017, issued under the 1961 Act; not re-checked for the 2025 Act).

sources.title: Income-tax Act, 2025, section 393 (Tax to be deducted at source), Table in sub-section (1)
